title: Steven Hahn v. Philadelphia Metro West Presbytery
disposition_detail: Case 2011-16, a duplicate of 2011-15, was denied. The SJC upheld Presbytery’s refusal to institute process against Lisa Ridenour, RE Glen Ridenour, and TE Eric Huber.
first_summary: Hahn challenged Presbytery’s refusal to appoint a prosecutor and institute process against three people he had accused. The SJC denied the complaint because Presbytery found BCO 31-8 applicable to Hahn’s accusations and found insufficient evidence of a strong presumption of guilt. The record showed no clear error warranting reversal of those judgments.
summary: Hahn challenged Presbytery’s refusal to appoint a prosecutor and institute process against Lisa Ridenour, RE Glen Ridenour, and TE Eric Huber. The SJC denied the complaint because Presbytery found BCO 31-8 applicable to Hahn’s accusations and found insufficient evidence of a strong presumption of guilt; the record showed no clear error. A separate concurrence agreed with the result but cautioned against implying that filing charges generally compels process, emphasizing a church court’s broader discretion to investigate and decline prosecution.
